articles.title: Bitcoin bears pay to bet on further declines as futures positions near yearly lows
articles.snippet: Overall demand for leveraged exposure remains weak, marked by sliding futures open interest. The capital that's still in the market appears skewed toward bearish positions.

articles.title: RedotPay completes financial audit as it presses ahead with U.S. IPO plans
articles.snippet: The stablecoin payments company said the audit is part of its preparations to go public, disputing an August report that the listing had been put on hold.

articles.title: Solana ETFs draw record $188 million in a week as Bitwise takes two-thirds of inflows
articles.snippet: All seven funds attracted money, while Friday’s $87 million intake set a daily record.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures decline as Trump won’t rule out more Iran strikes
articles.snippet: Trump on Sunday didn’t rule out additional strikes on Iran before the midterm elections, even as he said the war could end soon.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
articles.snippet: Buterin wants Ethereum to do far more work without forcing every computer on the network to repeat the same calculations.
